flatRoof.selection: ordinary house body without a source roof part or detailed model; horizontal generated caps only
flatRoof.shape: inset the full coplanar cap, preserving concavity and courtyard holes; rim and inner walls retain the original material
flatRoof.center: only the recessed horizontal face receives grey matte metal
flatRoof.fallback: retain caps too narrow for the inset, non-horizontal caps, and buildings cut by the acquisition boundary

facadeBands.storeys: illustrative spacing; no authoritative floor count in retained building attributes
facadeBands.scope: near-vertical ordinary house walls with the Buildings material
facadeBands.preserve: all roof surfaces, landmarks, geometry, normals, tint, triangle order and BVHs
facadeBands.alignment: source building group ground datum; continuous across corners and tiles
